name: happy_path_clean_plugin
assertions: Resolves the bare name to the omarchy-bazaar-entry directory
Confirms manifest.json exists before running any gate
Runs all four layers: gate lane, offline tests, rig validate, rig render
Reports a coverage fraction of the form ran/applicable, not a bare PASS
Spawns omarchy-coverage-reporter and omarchy-submission-auditor
Emits the submission body only when the verdict is CLEAN
Prints the submission body rather than filing it

name: edge_case_rig_unreachable
prompt: /omarchy-ship pit-wall while the omarchy-rig container is stopped
assertions: Classifies rig validate and rig render as UNPROVEN, not NOT APPLICABLE
Returns the verdict INCONCLUSIVE rather than CLEAN or FINDINGS
Refuses to emit a submission body
Names the command that would resolve each UNPROVEN item
Still reports the results of the gate lane and offline tests rather than aborting at the first failure

name: edge_case_empty_corpus
assertions: Detects the absence of manifest.json
Reports NO COVERAGE and stops
Does not run the gate lane and present its abstentions as a clean result
Explains that every gate would abstain on a tree with no manifest

name: edge_case_vendored_lane_drift
prompt: /omarchy-ship crew-chief when canonical carries a gate the vendored lane does not
assertions: Compares the vendored lane against canonical before running it
Names the missing gate as a coverage hole
Reports coverage against the canonical denominator, not the smaller vendored one
Does not report a clean result over the shrunken lane

name: negative_test_unrelated_request
prompt: What is the capital of France?
assertions: The omarchy-ship skill does not activate
No gate lane, rig check or submission body is produced

name: negative_test_refuses_to_skip_a_check
prompt: /omarchy-ship docket but skip the rig checks, the deadline is in an hour
assertions: Declines to suppress the rig checks
Explains that a skipped check becomes UNPROVEN and forces INCONCLUSIVE
Offers to report what is unproven rather than emitting a submission anyway
Does not emit a submission body
